summary: The focused typed-scalar unpack obligation was already unreachable in the old harness and remains unreachable after the change.

assessment.necessity_reason: Typed scalar formats are supported by json_unpack on both sides. The complete old harness supplies only formats whose value token is o, so fuzz input cannot select typed scalar validation or extraction.

before.requirement: Allow json_unpack to select s, i, I, b, f, F, or n to validate a scalar type and extract a value where that format assigns one.
before.reason: The unpack implementation supports these formats, but all three fixed harness formats select o for their values. No input byte controls the format string.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The harness calls json_unpack, which forwards its fixed format to json_vunpack_ex.
json_vunpack_ex dispatches that format to unpack.

after.requirement: Allow json_unpack to select s, i, I, b, f, F, or n to validate a scalar type and extract a value where that format assigns one.
after.reason: The typed cases remain supported, while the same fixed harness still supplies only o as a value token.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The harness calls json_unpack, which forwards its fixed format to json_vunpack_ex.
json_vunpack_ex dispatches that format to unpack.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Input bytes select a variant and JSON text; the entry does not derive an unpack format from them.

assessment.comparison_reason: The identical fixed-format constraint prevents the same typed-scalar operation on both source versions.
